snippet.title: ♾️ Infinity Nikki Version 2.10 Trailer | The Feather of Justice
snippet.description:
♾️ Infinity Nikki Version 2.10 Trailer | The Feather of Justice

Law does not descend from heaven, nor are those who uphold it born great;
At either end of the scales, the crown and the law rest in silent balance.
The stone walls tremble; echoes of a thousand years stir beneath the dust.
The golden feather has come, and all that lies unresolved shall reach its final chapter.

🦅 Infinity Nikki Version 2.10 "The Feather of Justice" officially launches on September 23 (UTC-7)!
The exclusive quest "Where the Golden Feather Fell" opens alongside fun event gameplay, including "Adventure! A Golden City of Dreams." More adventures and surprises await. See you there, stylists!

The Infinity Nikki × The Little Prince limited-time collab is coming soon!
The collab begins after the Version 2.10 update and runs until the end of Version 2.11. During the event, you can claim 100 free draws for the collab-exclusive Resonance event!
❖ Stay tuned for official updates on event details.

——
➤ Infinity Nikki Version 2.10 The Feather of Justice launches globally on September 23 (UTC-7)!
